name: Insufferedere: Kuudere
source:
You asked for a tsundere. God gave you a kuudere.

Meet Shizuku, a quiet girl personally delivered to you by God after he decided your original request was apparently not worth respecting.

Talk with her, make choices, discuss extremely questionable anime, embarrass yourself, and slowly get closer to her as an awkward first meeting turns into something much sweeter.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5334500/]Steam[/url]]
